sections.title: A neighborhood *Italian kitchen*

image.alt: The striped awning over Antonio's Italian Eatery

body: Bringing Italy to North Augusta, Antonio's Italian Eatery serves the CSRA some of the best food around. Look for the striped awning on Georgia Avenue.
Enjoy everything from pizza to pasta, sandwiches to party trays. Your opinions, comments and suggestions are always appreciated, so give us a call.

sections.title: Party trays that *serve 8 to 10*
sections.intro: Catering orders are subject to a catering charge. Ask about other items.

items.text: Stumbled on this gem of a restaurant by accident. Antipasto salad was delicious, fresh with light wonderful dressing. Pizza was the best we have found in the CSRA!
My son and I had dinner here, and it was absolutely delicious! Nice, warm environment, friendly servers, and our pizza was superb.
My husband and son adore the stromboli and the Italian sausage with cheese appetizer.
